title: Michigan elections: School districts seeking nearly $4 billion in bonds
summary_en: School districts are asking voters to borrow money for infrastructure projects. Leaders say they know families are facing increased household costs, but their options are limited.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Michigan elections: School districts seeking nearly $4 billion in bonds

title: Michigan wants to scrap rarely used special ed rule. Child advocates fear harm
summary_en: The state Department of Education can mandate that students with disabilities ‘stay put’ in their school settings while it investigates special ed complaints. A plan to remove that provision has sparked an outcry.
author: Isabel Lohman
title_cn: Michigan wants to scrap rarely used special ed rule. Child advocates fear harm

title: MSU trustee sues, says ethics policy is unconstitutional
summary_en: Michigan State University Trustee Mike Balow has filed a federal lawsuit aimed at modifying an updated ethics policy that includes a “loyalty” clause and more.
author: Kim Kozlowski
title_cn: MSU trustee sues, says ethics policy is unconstitutional
